integrity: The unrestricted proof is algebraic and uses the published sharp endpoint inequality. Finite prime-field checks are corroboration, not proof. Mathematical independence has not been audited.
scientific_limitations: The original sharp constant and constant-modulus necessity belong to prior work. The additional claim classifies all complex phases only for the anisotropic two-dimensional paraboloid in odd characteristic, q congruent to 3 modulo 4; it does not address other surfaces or exponents. An unindexed equivalent theorem remains a priority risk.
title: Complete complex extremizers for the anisotropic finite-field paraboloid
